note: Relayed from a trainee pilot's description of flying the circuit, not an official chart. Checkpoint coordinates were located individually (see each checkpoint's source/confidence) -- several checkpoints were first located via OpenStreetMap search (confidence: medium), several more via Google Maps links the user supplied directly (confidence: high, source field cites the link). Three checkpoints that stayed unlocated (Abeam tower, Small hills, L-shaped buildings) were removed from this file at the user's request rather than kept as unconfirmed placeholders -- if they're identified later, re-add them with a coords/source entry rather than guessing. The GPX track from an actual flight (arriving separately) will be used to check this geometry; conflicts will be flagged, not silently edited into this file.
distanceFieldNote: On upwind/crosswind/base/final, distanceNm is measured along that leg from its start. On downwind, the pilot's distances are ambiguous between 'along the leg' and 'straight-line distance from the airport' -- the described pattern (5, 4, ..., 1, abeam, 2, 3, 4, 5) only makes sense as airport-relative radial distance (closing in toward the abeam point, then opening back out), so downwind checkpoints use distanceFromAirportNm instead. This is an interpretation of the pilot's wording, not a literal field they specified -- flagged here rather than presented as fact.
